mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which negatively impacts equity valuations and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns despite high FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days when UNRATE increases by 0.2pp.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises but S&P 500 returns remain positive, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are negative, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High CPIAUCSL inflation leads to expected rate hikes, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 20 days when CPI exceeds 220.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is high but returns are positive, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) without employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises without PAYEMS growth but returns are positive, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but returns are negative, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises in late-cycle but returns are positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with high FEDFUNDS indicates stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 slows with high FEDFUNDS but returns are positive, the hypothesis fails.
